transcript.text: During my reconciliation of the late-produced onboarding export against the user-agreement database, I confirmed that exactly 312 of the 480 putative class members have executed agreements containing an arbitration provision. The remaining 168 putative class members do not have arbitration provisions in their agreements. This means we cannot compel arbitration across the entire putative class — only approximately 65% of the class would be subject to arbitration if we move to compel. I have not yet incorporated this reconciliation into the formal arbitration analysis, but the team should be aware that any arbitration strategy will need to account for the 168 users who fall outside the arbitration provisions.
